term.label: rRNA_21S

definition.text: A component of the large ribosomal subunit in mitochondrial rRNA.

comments: This term has been merged into mt_LSU_rRNA (SO:0002345) as part of reorganization of rRNA child terms 10 June 2021. Requested by EBI. See GitHub Issue #493.
